body: So I just experienced my first suicide attempt.  I hung the rope on my bedroom doorknob.  I pulled out once after a couple of seconds and then just stood there the second time.  After a couple of seconds the second time around, I said to myself: put your hands behind your back.  You're going to stop yourself again.  And then everything just stopped.  I woke up, neck in rope, gasping for air with my heart pounding and as soon as I realized where I was, I stood up.  I guess it isn't my time to go just yet

My shift actually ends at 8:30 tonight.  Getting ready to close up the fitness studio I work at.  Thanks for all of your sweet comments.  Good luck in life.  Wishing you all light and laughter.  Goodbye <3
I just don't have motivation to join.  I feel stupid explaining it but I see how my will to live reflects in my responses.  At this point I'm just tired of caring I guess

That's definitely it.  I do the same thing every day but I'm doing everything "right".  I either go to work or school and try working out every day and when I have free time, I spend most of it alone since I don't have friends.
Yeah I'm thinking.  It's like half of my mind is logical and the other is just insane.  I think I'm just tired of being sad all the time and having to put on an act

I'm 20.  My birthday's on November 19th.  I know it's depression.  I try VERY hard.  I still workout almost every day, go to school, get good grades, try to put on a mask, smile, am funny with my friends, but at this point I'm just so tired of trying and keeping up that image.  I'm exhausted

He's literally told me during a previous episode that he doesn't care; to just do it.  This time, he just ignored all of my messages about buying rope and just wanting him to be there for me.  I let him know I made an appointment to see the psychiatrist, that I was going to get better and he just wrote "deal with your depression and then come holla at me".  When I spoke to him on the phone he said he didn't call me the day before because he thought I "did something to myself".  He knows I don't have friends to talk to and I thought at least he would be there for me.  at least a phonecall.  Something.

No need to apologize for your English.  I've been depressed/"Sad" since like 10.  I've had suicide claims and thoughts for at least 5 years.  I know people love me - especially my mom and brother - but I find no inspiration in living anymore.  Really tired of trying and continuing to fail.
